semiconductor_relevance: High — Shanghai Qianghua Industrial Corporation specializes in quartz processing and provides essential quartz components for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Shanghai Qianghua Industrial Corporation is a high-tech enterprise with over 20 years of experience in quartz processing, offering a complete range of quartz components for 6-inch, 8-inch, and 12-inch semiconductor customers. The company emphasizes quality and innovation, supported by advanced manufacturing equipment and certifications in quality and environmental management.
capabilities: Manufacturing of quartz components for DIF, ETCH, and CVD processes
Heat processing and machining of quartz materials
Production of fused quartz glass and sapphire fixtures

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shanghai and has been recognized as a high-tech enterprise by the Shanghai Municipal Government.
